script.title: SELF-CHECKOUT HELP
script.title_quote: Unexpected item in the bagging area
script.scene_zh: 超市自助結帳區 · 請店員幫忙
script.story_hook: The machine complains, and one kind staffer saves the day.
script.intro_zh: 自助結帳機一直抱怨，還好有位熱心的店員來幫忙。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today's dialogue untangles the self-checkout mess.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天的對話幫你解開自助結帳的小麻煩。
script.outro: And that's the bagging area solved! Shadow the help lines and try it yourself.
script.outro_zh: 裝袋區的難題就這樣解決了！跟著唸那些求助句，下次自己試試。
script.practice_intro_en: Your turn! Copy each line until it feels easy.
script.practice_intro_zh: 換你了！一句一句跟著唸，唸到輕鬆自然。
script.char_a_description: a young mother around thirty-two with long brown hair in a quick ponytail, a few strands falling across her face, wearing a denim jacket over a gray sweatshirt, black leggings, average build, slightly rushed smile.
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged man in his mid fifties with steel-gray buzzed hair and rectangular glasses, wearing a red store vest over a light blue shirt, khaki pants, tall and lean build, calm patient smile, a small keyring at his belt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, can you help me? My screen froze.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm kən ju hɛlp mi maɪ skrin froʊz/
dialogue.zh: 呃，可以幫我一下嗎？我的螢幕卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, ma'am. What does it say?
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，小姐。上面寫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Unexpected item in the bagging area.
dialogue.zh: 「裝袋區出現不明物品。」

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, that famous message!
dialogue.zh: 啊，那句很有名的提示語！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's frustrating, not funny.
dialogue.zh: 那是讓人抓狂，不好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry! Have you bagged anything yet?
dialogue.zh: 抱歉！您已經裝好什麼東西了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just apples and a loaf of bread.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈæpəlz ænd ə lɔf ʌv brɛd/
dialogue.zh: 只有蘋果和一條麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the scale... okay.
dialogue.zh: 我看看秤……好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's wrong with it?
dialogue.zh: 它哪裡有問題？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your bread hit the bag scale first.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr brɛd hɪt ðə bæɡ skɪl fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 您的麵包先碰到了裝袋區的秤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the machine counted it twice?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə məˈʃin ˈkaʊn tɪd ɪt twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 所以機器算了它兩次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. Clear the area for me.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。請幫我把那邊清空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? Everything off the shelf?
dialogue.zh: 像這樣？全部從架上拿下來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Now put the bread back.
dialogue.zh: 完美。現在把麵包放回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay... it shows one item now.
dialogue.zh: 好……現在只顯示一件了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? We're friends again.
dialogue.zh: 看到了吧？我們又變回朋友了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was fast! Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 好快！謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. What else is stuck?
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。還有哪裡卡住？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It wants approval for my drink.
dialogue.zh: 它要求核准我的飲料。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, the energy drink. It's age-checked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ði ˈɛnɚdʒi drɪŋk ɪts eɪʧ tʃɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 啊，是能量飲料，要查年齡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Age-checked? I'm thirty-two!
dialogue.zh: 查年齡？我三十二歲了耶！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No doubt, ma'am. I'll tap the okay.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ daʊt mæm aɪl tæp ði oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這我毫不懷疑，小姐。我點一下核准。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can just approve that?
dialogue.zh: 您可以直接核准它嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My job, my button. There, scan again.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ dʒɑb maɪ ˈbʌtən ðɛr skæn əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我的工作，我的按鈕。好，再掃描一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It worked! What about the bananas?
dialogue.zh: 成功了！那香蕉怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bananas need a code, not a barcode.
dialogue.zh: 香蕉要輸入代碼，不是掃描條碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A code? Where would I find that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə koʊd wɛr wʊd aɪ faɪnd ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 代碼？我要去哪裡找？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's 4011. All bananas are 4011.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈfɔr ˈzɪroʊ wʌn wʌn ɔl bəˈnænəz ɑr ˈfɔr ˈzɪroʊ wʌn wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 是4011。所有香蕉都是4011。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How was I supposed to know that?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ wʌz aɪ səˈpzd tə noʊ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 我怎麼可能知道啊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Nobody does. Press produce, then 4011.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæ ˈnoʊbədi dʌz prɛs ˈprəˌdus ðɛn ˈfɔr ˈzɪroʊ wʌn wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 哈！沒人知道的。按「蔬果」，再按4011。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done! The screen looks happy now.
dialogue.zh: 按好了！螢幕現在看起來很快樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does! Anything else today?
dialogue.zh: 真的耶！今天還有別的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do bags cost money here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡的購物袋要錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten cents each. Do you have yours?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn sɛnts itʃ du ju həv jʊrz/
dialogue.zh: 一個十美分。您自己有帶袋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do... in my car, of course!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du ɪn maɪ kɑr ʌv kɔrs/
dialogue.zh: 我有……在車上，當然啦！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want a paper bag while you run?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑnt ə ˈpeɪɚ bæɡ waɪl ju rʌn/
dialogue.zh: 您要去車上拿的話，先要個紙袋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, no. I'll pay the ten cents.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ noʊ aɪl peɪ ðə tɛn sɛnts/
dialogue.zh: 不用不用。我付這十美分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or I can void the bag fee, easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr aɪ kən vɔɪd ðə bæɡ fi ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 不然我可以幫您去掉袋子費，很簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That's so nice of you!
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？您人太好了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half my job is fixing machine fights.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf maɪ dʒɑb ɪz ˈfɪksɪŋ məˈʃin faɪts/
dialogue.zh: 我一半的工作，就是調解人和機器的戰爭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Machine fights! That's exactly this.
dialogue.zh: 人機大戰！說的就是現在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! True story. Card giving trouble?
dialogue.zh: 哈！都是真的。卡片也有問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah, it isn't reading at all.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，它完全讀不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the reader again, flat and slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə ˈridɚ əˈɡɛn flæt ænd sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 再試一次感應區，平平地、慢慢刷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like... this? Yes, approved!
dialogue.zh: 像這樣……？有！核准了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Whole cart, fully handled.
dialogue.zh: 看到了吧？整車都搞定啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I couldn't have done this without you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kʊdənt həv dʌn ðɪs wɪˈðaʊt ju/
dialogue.zh: 沒有您，我真的做不完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honestly, you did the hard parts.
dialogue.zh: 說真的，難的部分都是您自己完成的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time, can I ask for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm kən aɪ ɑsk fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 下次，我可以專門找您嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure! I'm Ray, lane seven.
dialogue.zh: 當然！我叫雷，負責七號機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ray with two Ys? That's new.
dialogue.zh: 拼兩個Y的雷？我第一次聽說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Just R-A-Y, short and easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæ dʒʌst ɑr eɪ weɪ ʃɔrt ænd ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 哈！就是R-A-Y，短又好記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, Ray. You saved my morning.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝您，雷。您救了我的上午。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have a good one! That's the job.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ə ɡʊd wʌn ðæts ðə dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 祝您一天愉快！這就是我的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The machine and I are friends now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃin ænd aɪ ɑr frɛndz naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我和這台機器現在是朋友了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the spirit! Come back anytime.
dialogue.zh: 就是這種精神！隨時歡迎再來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Bread intact, apples safe.
dialogue.zh: 我會的。麵包完好，蘋果也平安。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! A perfect checkout story.
dialogue.zh: 哈！一個完美的結帳故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you next week, lane seven!
dialogue.zh: 下週見，七號機！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye! Bring those bags next time.
dialogue.zh: 再見！下次記得從車上帶袋子喔。

script.youtube_title_en: "Unexpected Item in the Bagging Area" — Getting Help at a Self-Checkout
script.youtube_description:
60句自助結帳真實對話，聽完就能自己處理畫面卡住、年齡檢查、香蕉代碼和刷卡失敗！

這一集走進超市的自助結帳區。螢幕一直提示「裝袋區出現不明物品」，能量飲料又要查年齡。幸運的是，七號機的店員雷一步一步幫她把整車物品結算完成，還學會了好幾個實用說法。

你會練到：
- 請人帮忙：「Um, can you help me? My screen froze.」
- 處理裝袋區誤判：「Clear the area for me.」
- 輸入水果代碼：「Bananas need a code, not a barcode.」
- 刷卡失敗的救法：「Try the reader again, flat and slow.」

後半段為逐句聽力與跟讀練習，建議先聽兩遍，再一句一句跟著唸。

script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of real self-checkout English you can hear and use today.

In this episode, the screen keeps saying unexpected item in the bagging area, an energy drink needs an age check, and the card reader stops working. Luckily Ray from lane seven fixes every step, one friendly line at a time.

You will practice:
- Asking for help: Um, can you help me? My screen froze.
- Clearing the error: Clear the area for me.
- Entering a produce code: Bananas need a code, not a barcode.
- Fixing the card reader: Try the reader again, flat and slow.

The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing practice. Listen twice, then repeat every line out loud.

Great for A2 learners: no memorizing needed, just listen and you will start using it.

If you enjoy this lesson, subscribe, like, and turn on notifications for a daily English dialogue!

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish

這一集帶大家走進超市的自助結帳區，看一位媽媽在店員雷的幫忙下，從螢幕卡住一路走到順利結帳。
